influx_url_help: Base URL of the local InfluxDB on your Enpal box (e.g. http://192.168.1.100:8086).
influx_token_help: InfluxDB API token with read access. Stored encrypted in ioBroker.
influx_org_help: InfluxDB organisation ID (see InfluxDB UI under Data).
influx_bucket_help: Bucket name that Enpal writes to (typically enpal or similar).
interval_s_help: How often energy data and wallbox status are refreshed (minimum 5 seconds).
show_sync_info: Show info messages for each synchronization
show_sync_info_help: Log a successful InfluxDB sync as an info message (useful for debugging).
wallbox_enabled: Enable wallbox control (uses same IP as InfluxDB)
wallbox_enabled_help: Creates wallbox_control states and connects to the Enpal Box web UI on port 80 (same host as InfluxDB). Requires firmware 8.50+.
wallbox_help_intro:
Wallbox control creates the channel enpal.<instance>.wallbox_control.

Requirements:
• Enpal Box firmware 8.50+
• ioBroker host reachable on the local network (same IP as InfluxDB, HTTP port 80)
• Checkbox above enabled — then restart the adapter instance
wallbox_help_states:
Data points (under enpal.<instance>.wallbox_control):

StateReadWriteDescription
startnoyesButton — set to true to start charging
stopnoyesButton — set to true to stop charging
modeyesyesSet charge mode: eco, solar, full, smart
currentModeyesnoCurrent mode reported by the wallbox (e.g. Eco, Solar, Full)
connectorStatusyesnoOCPP connector status (see below)
automaticChargeStatusyesnoAutomatic charge on plug-in: On / Off (read-only — change in Enpal app)
wallbox_help_modes:
Charge modes (write via mode, read via currentMode):

ModeDescription
ecoEco charging — optimised for low cost / grid-friendly charging
solarSolar charging — prefer PV surplus
fullFull / fast charging — maximum charging power
smartSmart mode — Enpal-managed charging strategy

Control uses the Enpal Box /wallbox page via Blazor SignalR (same approach as the Home Assistant Enpal integration).
wallbox_help_connector:
Connector status (connectorStatus) — OCPP values from the wallbox, read from /deviceMessages:

ValueMeaning
AvailableConnector free, nothing plugged in
PreparingVehicle connected, session not started yet
ChargingActive charging — power is flowing
SuspendedEVVehicle paused (e.g. battery full); still plugged in
SuspendedEVSEWallbox paused power (e.g. load management)
FinishingSession ended, cable still connected
ReservedReserved for a future session
UnavailableTemporarily not usable
FaultedError reported by the wallbox
ConnectedVehicle connected (Enpal-specific)

Typical flow: Charging → (stop or full battery) → SuspendedEV or Finishing → unplug → Available.
After a full charge, SuspendedEV is normal — the car stopped drawing power.
wallbox_help_automation:
Automation tips:

• Start charging: set mode (e.g. solar), then start = true
• Stop charging: set stop = true → status often becomes Finishing
• Ready to charge (plugged in, not charging): connectorStatus is one of SuspendedEV, SuspendedEVSE, Connected, or Preparing — and not Charging
• Do not trigger start solely on SuspendedEV — this also appears when the battery is full
• Combine with your own conditions (PV surplus, time window, vehicle SoC from another source)

Not supported from ioBroker: changing automatic charge on plug-in (automaticChargeStatus) — use the Enpal app.
